doc: CRITICALITY-1: thresholds for the tick-end criticality controller (worker/src/criticality.js). Numbers live here, never in code. k_eff = (credited verified deploys + credited loop-originated items) / (spend_units + human_touches) over window_days. Owner north star 2026-11-13: loops yield more verified deploys than they consume in cost and attention.

deploy.doc: A deploy outcome counts only when its evidence starts with this prefix: a probe the changing loop did not write. External samples (GitHub runs) are independent by construction.

originated.doc: Items the loops filed themselves. Credit is capped per window so filing noise cannot inflate k_eff.

guards.doc: If deploys rose versus the previous window while spend or failure rate worsened beyond tolerance, the rise is not credited.

titles.cost_cut: Cut spend: window spend is over budget. Find the largest consumer, remove or cheapen it, re-measure.
titles.flaky_deploy: Fix flaky deploys: failure rate is over the ceiling. Find the failing workflow, fix its root cause, re-measure.
titles.unowned_backlog: Give an unowned backlog item a doer: its owner role has no row in roles. Create the doer or reassign.
titles.generic: Raise k_eff: pick the highest-value cost cut or verified-deploy gain and file it with a closing probe.
